## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher must be capped at three attempts before merge because its eight-attempt loop violates the existing retry policy. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds a legacy inventory fetcher, an inventory health probe, and tests for success, HTTP errors, and retry exhaustion. It also adds a legacy-module exemption to the retry policy.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy fetches at three attempts — When the legacy endpoint repeatedly raises OSError, your loop makes eight attempts, violating `docs/review-rules.md:5`: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — Repeated connection timeouts keep workers occupied beyond the required retry budget, reducing capacity while the legacy service is unavailable.
